subject: SAML assertion samples & SCIM reconciliation logs for HealthBridge SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Alice Moreno <alice@healthbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: security@healthbridge.com
Date: 2027-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM reconciliation for SOC2 intake

Hi Markus / Laura,

We're preparing HealthBridge's SOC2 intake and the auditors have asked for a few specific artifacts related to access control and provisioning:

- A pair of sample SAML assertion XMLs (one interactive login, one service-to-service) with identifying attributes included (NameID, eduPersonPrincipalName, groups/roles). Assertions can be redacted for PII, but we need realistic attribute sets and timestamps.
- A SCIM delta export covering the last 30 days showing user create/update/delete events (CSV is fine). We need column names and an explanation of the ‘meta’ fields.
- The current RBAC/role matrix mapping (which roles have what permissions) and a short attestation that roles are scoped to least privilege for HealthBridge tenant.

Can you send these artifacts (redacted copies OK) and a single-paragraph note describing how you generate and retain SCIM audit logs (retention period, where logs are stored, and whether they are encrypted at rest)?

Target: auditors want the bundle by EOD Monday (2027-08-16). Let me know if that's feasible or if we need a stub first.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Moreno
Security Engineering | HealthBridge

-----Original Message-----

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Alice Moreno <alice@healthbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM reconciliation for SOC2 intake

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redacted bundle and the short attestation. Planned deliverables:

1) saml-assertions-sample-redacted.txt — two SAML assertion examples (interactive + machine), with NameID, assertion timestamps, audience and authnContext preserved; all user-identifying fields redacted (email -> <redacted-email>)
2) scim-delta-202707.csv — delta export for 2027-07-15 to 2027-08-14 with event type (create/update/delete), SCIM path, and meta fields (version, lastModified) documented
3) rbac-role-matrix-v2.xlsx — simplified role -> permission mapping for HealthBridge tenant, with a one-paragraph attestation in the cover sheet
4) short note: how SCIM events are generated, where logs live (s3://redwood-shared/audit/scim/healthbridge, encrypted with customer KMS key), retention (90 days by default; longer available on request)

FAQ notes:
- We won't include raw PII in the attachments; auditors often want to see realistic attributes.
- If auditors require raw assertion XMLs with full NameIDs, we can produce them under an NDA and with a hashed identifier.

I'll attach the redacted artifacts in the next email and drop them to the shared Drive link (https://drive.google.com/healthbridge/soc2-evidence/ID:0A1b2C3).

Cc'ing Priyom to produce the SCIM delta and Laura to confirm the role matrix state for HealthBridge.

Best,
Markus Klein
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-14T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM reconciliation for SOC2 intake

Markus / Laura — forwarding my note; I've prepared the SCIM delta export and documented the column mapping. Attachments I will upload: scim-delta-202707.csv (redacted), and a small README that explains the meta fields and the SCIM changelog format.

Notes for auditors:
- scim-delta-202707.csv contains columns: event_id, event_time, event_type (create/update/delete), scim_path (e.g., /Users/12345), actor (system/service), meta.version, meta.lastModified
- The export was generated from the provisioning service logs; personally identifiable values (emails, displayName) are redacted to <redacted> when included in artifacts.
- SCIM events are stored in an S3 bucket encrypted with our HSM-backed KMS key. Access to the bucket is role-restricted; bucket policies and object ACLs are documented in the Drive folder.

I'll upload by 14:45 PST and will leave a comment on the Drive link once done.

— Priyom
Sr. Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----

From: Alice Moreno <alice@healthbridge.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, security@healthbridge.com
Date: 2027-08-14T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM reconciliation for SOC2 intake

Markus / Priyom / Laura — thanks, we received the Drive note and the three attachments. A couple quick follow-ups the auditors flagged when scanning the samples:

- Can you confirm that the RBAC matrix reflects the tenant-scoped roles (i.e., roles shown are HealthBridge-only and do not include cross-tenant admin roles)? Auditors want explicit confirmation.
- Please confirm the retention policy for SCIM/provisioning audit logs (documented E2E) and whether log access is logged (i.e., access to S3 objects produces audit events).

If you can drop a one-line confirmation for each item, that will let us close this ticket with the auditor.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Alice
Security Engineering | HealthBridge

Attachments referenced: saml-assertions-sample-redacted.txt (attached), scim-delta-202707.csv (attached), rbac-role-matrix-v2.xlsx (attached)
